instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-14_input.step. Split the original 130 x 60 x 22 mm body into three independent solids by removing two full-height gaps: X=38..44 and X=82..90. Keep the left solid spanning X=0..38, the middle solid spanning X=44..82, and the right solid spanning X=90..130, all with Y=0..60 and Z=0..22. Cut a vertical through hole of diameter 12 mm through the middle solid at (63,30). Add 4 mm chamfers to the four top outside edges of the right solid. Export a three-solid compound as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-14_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). In this image, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-14_input.step`.
